subject: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Healthcare Inc
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Johnson <ava.johnson@healthcare-inc.com>, Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@healthcare-inc.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Healthcare Inc

Hi Ava / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery so we’re all aligned and to make the next steps easy to follow.

Pain points you called out:
- Hard to detect regressions in prompt-output quality after model/infra changes; current detection is manual and slow.
- Lack of per-route token cost visibility tied to prompts and model variants.
- No standard golden prompt set or regression alerting across teams (clinical triage + intake flows).
- Need trace-level hooks for debugging model outputs tied back to request metadata (user id, prompt version, route).

Current stack / constraints:
- Primary infra: AWS (EKS) and a managed RAG service for vector storage; models currently served via a mix of vendor endpoints and small in-house endpoints.
- Compliance: PHI-sensitive workflows; must support VPC/private deployment and strict audit logs.
- Success timeline: pilot with one flow in Q3, expand if metrics meet SLAs/cost targets.

Success criteria you mentioned:
1) Automated regression detection on golden prompt set with weekly alerts and one-click rollback guardrail.
2) Dashboards showing per-route latency, token cost, and quality delta vs baseline.
3) Tracing hooks that capture request metadata and model version for post-incident debugging.
4) Proof-of-concept (PoC) within 6-8 weeks for the intake flow with reduced manual QA time.

What Redwood can provide (high level):
- Golden-prompt management and eval harness that runs nightly regression checks.
- Tracing hooks and structured logs with linkages to dashboard traces and per-request artifacts.
- Per-route dashboards (cost/latency/quality) and regression alerts tied to configurable thresholds.
- Private deployment option and audit log export to your KMS/HSM-backed storage for compliance.

Proposed next steps:
1) Share PoC scope & eval plan (attached) for the intake flow — I’ve attached an MVP evaluation plan and the initial golden prompt set template.
2) Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with your infra and security leads (suggested attendees: Tom, your infra sec lead, Rafael + our infra engineer). Rafael — can you join to cover deployment options?
3) Confirm which intake flow (initially we discussed Patient Intake triage) and provide a short sample of 100 prompts/responses for baseline eval.

Attachments: HW-2026-058_MVP-eval-plan.pdf, golden-prompt-sets.csv

If that all looks right I’ll send a calendar invite for next week with a high-level agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
